definitions.gloss: box tissues; tissue box; boxed facial tissues
definitions.explanation: Facial tissues sold in a rectangular box, as opposed to pocket tissues. A ubiquitous household item in Japan found in virtually every home, office, and car.

examples.english: The drugstore had five-box packs of tissues on sale, so I bought in bulk.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{箱|はこ}→箱：02162_hako⟧ (box) and ⟦ティッシュ→ティッシュ：08816_tisshu⟧ (tissue, from English). In Japan, box tissues are typically sold in multi-packs of five and are a staple household purchase. Distinguished from ⟦ポケット→ポケット：02964_poketto⟧⟦ティッシュ→ティッシュ：08816_tisshu⟧ (pocket tissues), which are commonly handed out for free on streets as advertising.

- {箱|はこ}ティッシュ{五箱|ごはこ}⟦パック→パック：11002_pakku⟧: five-box tissue pack
- {箱|はこ}ティッシュ⟦カバー→カバー：07812_kabaa⟧: tissue box cover
- {箱|はこ}ティッシュ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧: to buy box tissues
